contract.reference: User-supplied web.png, character in the center viewport; unseen back/top are inferred
contract.scope: One isolated study; no other starter replacement, upload, renderer architecture or format changes
invariants: Exact palette and four parts; no glasses
Fixed hero camera, rest pose and stage

requirements.evidence: Fixed exact-preset capture; complete shoes and platform visible. Existing opaque pipeline only; no real-time shadows added.

Foundation now covers the beveled head and intersecting roots are united. Front silhouette improved, but side/back locks remain too regular and fused; top has deep root creases. Not yet reference fidelity.

Static silhouette has slimmer tapered sleeves, tucked shoulders, a pulled-in waistband and smaller hood. Surface-fitted pocket no longer floats; slight edge aliasing remains. Animation is a separate failed gate.
Broad fleece/dye variation now reads at the fixed runtime scale. Denim is deeper indigo with lower-contrast seams. No claim that individual fibers survive the 256px runtime atlas.
All four lace rows sit on the leather upper; corrected socks cover the calves without hiding the laces. Visible in hero, side and walk views.
Existing elbow/jump stress views show rigid sleeves and hand fit defects. Not a topology-budget problem.

Five source GLBs fresh-imported; assembled portable GLB exported and fresh-imported again. Triangle counts, evaluated rest bounds, UVs and custom normals match. See fresh-import/report.json and its six rendered views.

iterations.defect: Helmet volume and side locks cutting into scalp
iterations.repair: Reduce head width/depth 5%/3%, narrow front locks and orient side ribbons tangentially
iterations.evidence: iterations/hair-fit: exposed head corners revealed the ellipsoidal foundation mismatch

iterations.repair: Rounded-box crown envelope instead of spherical radius falloff
iterations.evidence: iterations/hair-foundation: no exposed skin, but overly visible flat crown

iterations.defect: Side/back roots buried in new foundation
iterations.repair: Raise curved roots over the crown and lift the front foundation edge
iterations.evidence: iterations/hair-crown: covered crown, intersecting roots remain

iterations.repair: Voxel union and modest surface relaxation before UV bake; unchanged delivery ceilings
iterations.evidence: iterations/hair-sculpt: cleaner joined front/side roots, residual top creasing recorded

iterations.repair: Measured loft changes and ray-fitted subdivided pocket panel

iterations.defect: Fine-only fleece and uniform navy denim
iterations.repair: Two-scale material variation, indigo dye and chestnut color tuning
iterations.evidence: iterations/fabric-scale: cloth variation visible at identical camera and runtime resolution

iterations.defect: Three lace rows occluded by socks
iterations.repair: Surface-fit laces and narrow sock envelope
iterations.decision: reject sock offset, retain fitted laces
iterations.evidence: iterations/sneaker-fit: laces improved but front calves exposed through socks

iterations.defect: Calf/sock overlap and shoulder gap in walk
iterations.repair: Recenter socks around calves, move lace rows onto vamp, bury shoulder tips farther inside torso; correct standalone glTF tint factors
iterations.decision: keep as review candidate, not production replacement
iterations.evidence: beauty, walk-side, six fresh-import views; bend and jump-stress still fail

result.overall: Improved static art candidate. Reference hair fidelity and articulated garment/limb deformation remain failed gates. No publishing or starter replacement.
